page: Microsoft Azure M64dms_v2 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the MDSMediumMemoryv2 family. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is equipped with 1792.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 28.0 GB per vCPU.

This server configuration includes 2097 GB of local SSD storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. There are no integrated GPUs present on this instance, and it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a resource density perspective, the M64dms_v2 offers high memory capacity relative to its compute core count, making it a specialized option for memory-bound workloads rather than general-purpose compute. The inclusion of local SSD storage provides fast local scratch space, though users requiring high GPU acceleration or specific cryptographic hardware acceleration flags will need to consider alternative instance types.

The hardware profile is designed for memory-intensive workloads, large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, and enterprise applications requiring substantial RAM allocations alongside dedicated CPU resources.
